## Goal

Separate public summaries from scan frontiers, budget before materialization, use path-free query/revision-bound cursors and effective user policy, preserve typed errors and freshness/coverage semantics. Carry measured/unknown occurrence intervals through provenance, overlap queries and versioned exports.

- `AC-TASK-552-01` — All ten tools and two resources pass isolated real-IPC tests; basename/hashed outputs including cursors leak no path; changing policy/exclusions is immediately visible; stale/missing evidence is explicit; responses honor selected row/byte budgets.
